alternatives_rejected.why: Latency alone would fit a delay, but socket usage up 535% (z=107) is the largest non-latency deviation (E3), so socket is the more specific explanation. Callers seeing more slowdown (17.84x vs 5.29x own, E2) is also consistent with connections queuing on exhausted sockets.
CPU deviation (z=52.5) is about half the socket deviation (z=107) in E3, so it is more likely a side effect of connection churn.
It does not appear among the top deviations in the all-service ranking (E1); every top signal except the frontend error rate belongs to recommendationservice (E1, E3).

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll the recommendationservice pod to clear the leaked or exhausted sockets. Then check connection pooling and socket limits (for example the gRPC channel reuse toward productcatalogservice), and watch frontend error rates recover.
